SELECT t.project_id, t.project_name, a.area_name, a.area_id, u.nickname as project_man_name, u.id as project_man, u2.nickname as device_man_name, u2.id as device_man, t.project_year, t.lng, t.lat FROM project_manage t left join admin_area a on a.area_id = t.area_id left join system_users u on u.id = t.project_man left join system_users u2 on u2.id = t.device_man where t.deleted = 0
and t.project_man like concat('%',#{reqVO.projectMan},'%')
and t.project_name like concat('%',#{reqVO.projectName},'%')
and t.area_id = #{reqVO.areaId}
